context:
Start with diagnostic (w1) to understand whether dsqgen works locally on DuckDB.
If DuckDB succeeds, the issue is ClickHouse-adapter-specific query setup.
If DuckDB also fails, the dsqgen binary is the root cause.

For the code fix, add a guard in power_test.py's _run_power_test() method:
after query generation, check len(queries) == 0 and raise a descriptive error
rather than iterating over an empty list. In queries.py, track per-query failures
and raise when all queries fail.
description:
ClickHouse SF1 runs for tpcds and tpcds_obt show power_test status "COMPLETED" with
duration 0ms and an empty queries list. The phase silently swallows a query generation
failure, reporting success when zero queries actually executed.

Two candidate root causes:

Path A (most likely): dsqgen binary missing/failing silently. TPCDSQueryManager.get_all_queries()
in benchbox/core/tpcds/queries.py catches dsqgen exceptions per-query and skips them. If all 99
fail, it returns an empty dict. The power test runner iterates over zero queries and reports
COMPLETED.

Path B: _preflight_validate_generation() in power_test.py raises RuntimeError, caught at the
phase level, returning an empty result list.

Verification showed tpcds_obt did not share the same root cause. Base tpcds was fixed by
surfacing zero-query dsqgen failures, while tpcds_obt required adapter routing changes so it
runs through the generic OBT power-test path instead of the specialized TPC-DS stream runner.

This is the highest-priority fix because it blocks ~195 queries across both benchmarks and
masks the actual root cause (likely dsqgen binary availability on the ClickHouse Cloud host).

anti_patterns.dont: catch and swallow all exceptions in query generation
anti_patterns.why: individual query failures are acceptable but total failure must be surfaced
this masks dsqgen failures and produces misleading 'COMPLETED' status

preserves.behavior: Power test phase still completes normally when queries are present
TPCDSQueryManager.get_all_queries() continues to work when dsqgen succeeds for all queries
tpcds_obt executes its OBT query set via the generic adapter path instead of the base TPC-DS runner

verifications.description: Zero-query generation raises error instead of silent completion
verifications.expected: Tests pass showing FAILED status when 0 queries generated

In power_test.py, detect 0-query generation and set phase status to FAILED with descriptive error message. Also fixed schema.py to derive power_test phase status from real executions.
Add unit tests for zero-query detection in both queries.py and power_test.py
Re-run ClickHouse tpcds and tpcds_obt at SF1 to verify fix surfaces the actual error
